body.name: \(r_{\mathrm{up}}\)
body.construction: \(r_{\mathrm{np}}=n^{-1/(1+d/(2\gamma)+d/(4s))}\) if \(s<\frac{d/4}{1+d/(2\gamma)}\), and \(r_{\mathrm{np}}=n^{-1/(2+d/\gamma)}\) otherwise; \(r_{\mathrm{reg}}=N_{\mathrm{priv}}^{-\gamma/(\gamma+d)}\), \(r_{\mathrm{ho}}=N_{\mathrm{priv}}^{-q\gamma/\{(d+q)\gamma+qd\}}\), and \(r_{\mathrm{up}}=r_{\mathrm{np}}\vee r_{\mathrm{reg}}\vee r_{\mathrm{ho}}\).
